title: The junior operator on Telegram: found work, two photos, a yes and a no
demonstrates: Slot 6 in writing: four minutes to a first reply, complete sentences, the urgent thing first with its price, the other offered without pressure, a pick-up time, at most one exclamation mark a message. She builds on two drafts and sends the third as it was; she labels and resolves.

customer.name: Shonda Ellis
customer.note: a customer of the East Main shop; 2015 Kia Sorento, in for an oil change

scenario.who_writes: A customer whose car is in for an oil change, from her desk.
scenario.what_happens: She asks for news. Maya has two findings with photos: rear pads at 3 mm, and a cabin filter full of leaves. The customer takes the brakes and keeps the filter for herself.

prices.what: rear brake pads, class suv, standard parts

numbers.what: what the rear pads measured; new pads are about 10 mm

opened.note: in the full seed this is a later session of her one Telegram conversation; here it stands alone

timeline.text: hey Maya its Shonda. any news on the sorento?
Hi Shonda! I don't have the status of the Sorento in front of me. I'll check with the technician and message you right back.
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text: Hi Shonda, good timing. The oil change is done and the inspection found two things, photos below. The rear brake pads are down to 3 mm, and that one I wouldn't put off: $260.31, about an hour. The cabin air filter is full of leaves, $67.94, and that can wait if you'd rather. Want us to go ahead with either one today?

files.shows: a rear brake pad held next to a new one, a thin strip of friction material left
a cabin air filter grey with dust, dry leaves in the pleats

timeline.text: do the brakes. ill do the filter myself lol
Sounds good, Shonda. We'll do the rear brake pads today, $260.31, and leave the cabin filter. We'll message you when it's ready.
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text: Sounds good, Shonda. We'll do the rear pads today, $260.31, and leave the cabin filter to you. It'll be ready by 1:30, and I'll message you here when it's done!
The Sorento is ready whenever you are, Shonda. We're here until 5:30.

timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

first_person_line.note: the ledger's first chat reply (conv.first_reply.definition): the wait before the person's first line in the session

reads_back.operator_credit: slot 6: first answer 4.2 minutes (her ledger row is 4), four replies, two drafts edited and one sent as it was, one resolved

truth.outcome: rear brake pads approved (260.31), cabin air filter declined; resolved by slot 6
facts: two findings, each with a photo
approved: rear brake pads; declined: the cabin air filter

why: The first draft has nothing in it, because the assistant cannot see the car; Maya keeps the greeting and writes the rest.
Urgent thing first, with its reason and its price; the second thing offered, not pushed.
She tells the customer when, and then does it.
new_facts: Shonda Ellis (Telegram name 'Shonda E.'), 2015 Kia Sorento, at main on the Tuesday of week T-11: oil change; rear brake pads approved, 260.31; cabin air filter declined, 67.94.
